title.zh: 游戏化 AI 新媒体艺术工程师
title.en: Gamified AI New Media Art Engineer

short.zh: 从一个能运行的最小版本开始，学习怎样与 AI 协作、组织项目、测试版本，并把创意逐渐发展成可持续维护的新媒体系统。
short.en: Start from a working minimum version and learn how to collaborate with AI, structure a project, test versions, and develop an idea into a maintainable new-media system.

premise.zh: 重点不是掌握某一个 AI 工具，而是建立 FRAME → FILL → FINISH、Human-in-the-loop、V1 / V2 与长期开发的基本方法。
premise.en: The focus is not one AI tool, but a repeatable method: FRAME → FILL → FINISH, human-in-the-loop, V1 / V2, testing, and long-term development.
